title: Staying out of hiring decisions; everyone came by recommendation
summary: As the band's baby, Holmes kept out of discussions about new members, who always came on a recommendation.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Were there ever any discussions in the band, for instance, as to "We need another trumpet player; who shall we get?"

Well, yeah, but I stayed out of them things. I had nothing to do with who come in the band and who went out. That was their business. I had a hard enough time trying to keep myself there. I would never discuss the qualifications of another musician coming in the band. I had nothing to say about that. I was the baby in the band. When I say "baby," I was the baby...

Oh, sure. Sure, everybody come in there on a recommendation. Nobody just didn't walk in and say, "I'm a trumpet player. I want a job." No, they'd come in under the recommendation. I don't remember who recommended Otis, but he was well known around... You know, he was well-known around the musicians before he joined the band. He was a good trumpet player.
